subject: Offer approval: Senior ML Engineer (AuroraHealth) - Aaron Black
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Offer approval: Senior ML Engineer - Aaron Black

Team —

We completed final onsite loop yesterday with Aaron Black (referral via TalentBridge). He gave positive signals and is open to an offer. Requesting approvals to extend a standard senior-level package. Details below and attached: Aaron_Black_Resume.pdf, comp-band-MLE-2026.xlsx, proposed-offer-Aaron-Black.pdf.

Proposed package (first pass):
- Base: $220,000
- Target bonus: 12% (annual, discretionary)
- Equity: 0.45% (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff)
- Sign-on: $20,000 (one-time) conditional on notice period buyout
- Start date target: May 4, 2026

Notes: role will sit on the Inferencing Runtime team; manager is Markus. Headcount is approved against FY26 hiring plan (ML Eng - 2Q bucket). I flagged comp relative to band — looks slightly above midpoint but within allowable range for senior hires given market. Looking for:
- Marissa: comp confirmation and any compliance notes
- Laura: exec approval for sign-on exception (slightly above standard)
- Neha: please queue for final sign-off and DocuSign release once approved.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offer approval: Senior ML Engineer - Aaron Black

Thanks Markus — I reviewed the proposed package against the MLE comp bands. A few notes:

- Base: $220k is ~8% above the band midpoint for Senior ML Engineer in SF. Approvable under hiring manager discretion but requires VP sign-off for sign-on above standard.
- Bonus: 12% is fine (band target is 10–15%).
- Equity: 0.45% aligns with senior-level target; recommend standard 4-year schedule.
- Sign-on: our standard for this level is $10k; $20k requires an exception and justification (relocation/notice buyout). If this is to cover notice buyout, please include documented candidate confirmation and expected payout.
- Comp paperwork: I'll attach an annotated comp-band sheet and a clean offer template.

Attachment: comp-band-MLE-2026.xlsx (annotated)

Action items for approval:
1) Manager to confirm business justification for $20k sign-on (notice buyout amount).
2) Laura (People lead) — please approve the sign-on exception if rationale stands.
3) Neha — once approvals are in, I'll finalize the offer letter for DocuSign.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

----

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offer approval: Senior ML Engineer - Aaron Black

Thanks Marissa — good notes. Markus, quick confirm on the sign-on justification: Aaron indicated a 6-week notice and potential retention bonus required by his current employer; the $20k was proposed to cover partial notice payout and travel for a start in early May. Can you confirm the candidate has provided a written estimate for the buyout? If not, please ask TalentBridge to get that.

Vivek — can you confirm budget headcount (this is 1:1 replacement within the FY26 ML hiring bucket) and ok to proceed if Laura signs off on the sign-on exception?

Laura — appreciate a quick OK or a note if you'd prefer we cap sign-on at $10k and instead offer a one-time performance kicker payable at 6 months.

If we get both approvals today, Marissa and I will finalize verbiage and send via DocuSign by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Talent Partner (Tech Hiring)
Redwood Inference

Approve subject to:
- Final sign-on justification (written estimate from candidate / TalentBridge) OR reduce sign-on to $12,500 and add a $7,500 performance bonus payable at 6 months (still within comp expectations).
- Marissa to confirm: total OTE impact and budget coding (ENG-HR-26-ML).

If Laura signs the exception, green light to extend formal offer with the adjusted wording above.

Thanks —

Approved.

Decision and rationale: headcount budget confirmed by Vivek; comp falls within acceptable banding with a small sign-on exception given candidate constraints. Please proceed with the following final package:
- Base: $220,000
- Target bonus: 12%
- Equity: 0.45% (4y vesting)
- Sign-on: $12,500 now + $7,500 performance bonus at 6 months (subject to manager attestation)
- Standard benefits and relocation support per policy

Neha — please coordinate with TalentBridge to obtain the notice-buyout estimate and include it in the candidate file. Marissa — finalize the offer letter language (no explicit mention of 'buyout' payout to protect legal exposure; refer to 'one-time sign-on payment' and milestone conditions). Once ready, Neha, send to Aaron via DocuSign and loop legal if any changes to the template were required.

Related links: HR ticket HR-3421; DocuSign envelope link (please update once created).

Thanks everyone — good process.

Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
